SELECT all_days.day_type,
       COUNT(all_days.day_date) AS total_days,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(daily_orders.daily_revenue, 0)), 2) AS total_revenue_eur,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(daily_orders.daily_revenue, 0)), 2) AS avg_daily_revenue_eur
FROM all_days
LEFT JOIN daily_orders ON all_days.day_date = daily_orders.order_date
GROUP BY all_days.day_type
ORDER BY all_days.day_type DESC;
